content.text: Overlaps are nominal — colonnade is a perimeter ring, cella sits inside it. Stylobate: three stepped tan courses.
Base is in. Columns: 14 round 2x2 columns, 4 bricks tall with plate capitals.
Cella: white wall ring with a doorway, 4 courses.
Ceiling plates over the cella, then the entablature beam ring on the capitals.
Low-pitch stepped roof in five plate courses, ridge along the long axis.
